subject: Emotions
title: Disgust Sensitivity Spectrum
description: Learn Disgust Sensitivity Spectrum in one minute.

hook.text: Some people eat bugs happily. Others gag at the thought. Disgust sensitivity varies wildly.

buildup.text: Researchers measure this with the Disgust Scale. It rates reactions to scenarios like stepping in dog waste.

discovery.text: Women score higher on disgust sensitivity than men across all cultures. Hormones play a clear role.

twist.text: High disgust sensitivity predicts conservative political views. Low sensitivity predicts liberal ones.

climax.text: Your disgust threshold isn't just personal taste. It shapes your morals, your politics, and your friends.

punchline.text: How easily you say 'yuck' says a lot about you.

quiz.question: Who tends to score higher on disgust sensitivity?
